verdict.rationale: Retell documents its own real-time transcription mode setting. Developers can trade latency for accuracy, choosing interim results with low endpointing for speed or higher-endpointing, context-aware results for accuracy. That is a direct transcription-accuracy control, but the evidence never shows selecting the STT provider, choosing a transcription language model, or adding key-term/keyword boosting; the agent LLM setting is a different feature. Missing for 10: STT provider selection, transcription model choice, custom vocabulary/key-term boosting, independent evidence of transcription accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get accurate real-time transcription with control over the STT provider, language models, or key terms

citations.quote: Pick the right Retell transcription mode to balance accuracy against latency — interim results for speed or context-aware results for higher accuracy.
optimize for accuracy: uses the results with a higher endpointing setting
